overrides.title: Topology — manual tagging
overrides.caption: Manual layer on top of auto-discovery: tag a device as hypervisor or switch, or attach a device to a host. Changes show up on the map after refresh.
overrides.hint: Auto-discovery (FDB/LLDP) can't always tell which real host sits behind a shared port. Tagging by hand clears it up: a hypervisor nests its CTs under it, a switch manages its port, and "attach" hangs a device from a host.
overrides.empty: No overrides yet. Add the first one with the "Add" button.

warn.managed_by_firmware: This router ships a vendor AdGuard Home (GL.iNet). NetPulse won't manage it to avoid breaking its UI: configure it from the router's own interface.
warn.gateway_only: This module is only available on the gateway router. Enable the non-gateway permission to try it elsewhere.

adguard.nonGatewayWarning: AdGuard only filters DNS for the whole network from the gateway. Elsewhere it would only cover that router's clients, and deploying there requires enough free RAM and a gateway that does not already run AdGuard.

guestwifi.allowNonGateway: Allow guest WiFi on non-gateway routers
guestwifi.nonGatewayWarning: The guest network is created on this router with its own subnet and firewall, isolated from the LAN.

ddns.nonGatewayWarning: DDNS points a domain at the public IP. On a non-gateway router the scope depends on the network setup.

sqm.nonGatewayWarning: SQM prioritizes traffic and reduces latency under congestion on the selected interface. On a non-gateway router it only applies to its own link.
